messages:
elaine: Quick kickoff — I want to propose a small, customer-driven pilot: 'Ops Snapshot' widget for Console. Lightweight dashboard card combining per-route cost, error spike alerts, and trace links. Goal: self-serve visibility for PMs + developers.

raj: Love it. Scope question — do we include tracing hooks by default or make them opt-in?

sofia: Enterprise asks: they want per-customer and per-route cost breakdown (not just model-level). Also need error grouping by request fingerprint.

michael: Main constraint is telemetry overhead. If we attach traces too frequently we blow up costs. Idea: sample traces only when error rate > threshold and for routes with high token volume.

ops-anna: +1. Also need a clear rollout gate: sampling config, retention defaults, and KPI for not exceeding telemetry budget.

elaine: Proposed launch criteria: (1) ops snapshot shows cost + error + top contributing route within 1 click; (2) trace link opens to example span with request_id; (3) telemetry overhead < +10% for a medium production workload; (4) positive feedback from 3 pilot customers. Thoughts?

raj: Add canary gating: start with 5% of traffic on dedicated infra, measure p95 latency and error delta vs baseline. If error_delta <= 1.25x and p95 latency impact < 20ms we can expand.

sofia: For customer asks, we should expose a per-tenant cost filter and a way to pin a model+route combo for quick comparison.

michael: Implementation sketch: server-side sampling rule engine that emits trace_id on error rate triggers. Minimal change to runtime: push an opt-in header X-RW-TRACE: sample to the request router.

ops-anna: Example YAML for rollout/sampling config I mocked:

```yaml
sampling_rules:
  - name: error-spike-sample
    condition: 'errors_per_10k_tokens > 5'
    rate: 0.5
  - name: high-volume-route
    condition: 'avg_tokens_per_minute(route) > 10000'
    rate: 0.05
retention_days: 7
telemetry_budget_pct: 10
```

elaine: Nice. UX notes: widget should show a compact sparkline for cost + error, a top-3 contributors list (model, route, tenant), and a single CTA: "Open traces / Open evals". Keep config advanced and tucked into a settings dialog.

raj: Prioritization — put core card + per-route cost (MVP) in Q1 sprint. Tracing auto-sample + pinning in Q2. Error grouping improvements and per-tenant rollups as stretch.

sofia: Can we align with sales on which 3 customers to pilot? I have two candidates (FinApps + HealthSaaS). Need one more smaller PLG customer.

elaine: I'll ping solutions-eng to compile a short pilot pack and reach out.

deploy-bot: canary created: ops-snapshot-v1 -> namespace=dedicated-canary traffic=5% (automated check window=30m).

michael: When can the infra team add the header hook? ETA ~2 sprints if we prioritize kernel-safe path.

ops-anna: Ops checklist: telemetry budget alert, canary monitor dashboards (p95 latency, error_ratio, token_delta), rollback playbook.

elaine: Great thread — next steps: (A) Prod: raj + michael to spec server-side hook and canary checks; (B) UX: sofia to mock card and settings; (C) Pilot: ela ine to coordinate customers. I'll follow up with a short PRD by Friday. :rocket:
